searchSchema.description: Water-to-air heat pumps (Bosch CL, CF, CP 0.5-6 ton and EC 6-30 ton) at AHRI water-loop ratings. Enter design loads and the page returns models that meet the targets within your tolerance.

notes: Performance at AHRI/ISO 13256-1 water loop heat pump conditions: cooling 86°F EWT, 80.6°F DB / 66.2°F WB EAT; heating 68°F EWT, 68°F EAT.
Provide with copper coaxial water-to-refrigerant coil.
Provide with constant airflow ECM blower motor (1.25 - 6 ton).
Provide with constant torque ECM blower motor (0.5 - 1 ton).
Provide with MERV 8, 2" 4-sided filter rack (CL / CF / CP).
Provide with factory DDC controller, multi-protocol (BACnet, Modbus, N2), for building automation system integration.
